prediction.sql:

FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1."XCL_021" = T2."XCL_007"
INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1."XCL_026" = T3."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN colour AS T4 ON T1."XCL_022" = T4."XCL_005"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T5 ON T1."XCL_018" = T5."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T6 ON T5."XCL_010" = T6."XCL_003"
WHERE T2."XCL_008" = 'Male'
  AND T3."XCL_015" = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND T6."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
  AND T5."XCL_011" = (
      SELECT MAX(T5b."XCL_011")
      FROM hero_attribute AS T5b
      INNER JOIN attribute AS T6b ON T5b."XCL_010" = T6b."XCL_003"
      WHERE T6b."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
  )
ORDER BY T1."XCL_028" DESC

INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1."XCL_021" = T2."XCL_007"
INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1."XCL_026" = T3."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN colour AS T4 ON T1."XCL_022" = T4."XCL_005"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T5 ON T1."XCL_018" = T5."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T6 ON T5."XCL_010" = T6."XCL_003"
WHERE T2."XCL_008" = 'Male'
  AND T3."XCL_015" = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND T6."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
  AND T5."XCL_011" = (
      SELECT MAX(T5b."XCL_011")
      FROM hero_attribute AS T5b
      INNER JOIN attribute AS T6b ON T5b."XCL_010" = T6b."XCL_003"
      WHERE T6b."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
  )
ORDER BY T1."XCL_028" DESC

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    s.XCL_019 AS name,
    s.XCL_020 AS height,
    c.XCL_006 AS eye_color
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
JOIN colour c ON s.XCL_023 = c.XCL_005
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
WHERE 
    g.XCL_008 = 'Male'
    AND p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics'
    AND a.XCL_004 = 'Strength'
    AND ha.XCL_011 = (
        SELECT MAX(ha2.XCL_011)
        FROM hero_attribute ha2
        JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.XCL_010 = a2.XCL_003
        WHERE a2.XCL_004 = 'Strength'
    )
ORDER BY 
    s.XCL_020 DESC
